headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 280.9 Million Dollars From 194.4 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges rose to 280.9 million dollars from 194.4 million dollars, equal to 0.1041 percent of the 269.8 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bybit sent out 82.3 million dollars, the largest venue outflow, while Bitstamp took in 302.2 million dollars and Binance took in 98.8 million dollars, up from 57.1 million dollars.
author: jordan
